scope: Every tracked Java source file; all nested/member declarations inherit the file boundary even if lexical declaration extraction omits a local/anonymous type. File/blob/path-set equality is the completeness authority, not regex type counts.
verification: Compare sorted files[].path against git ls-tree -r --name-only <assessedCommit> product filtered to .java; compare each blob using git rev-parse <assessedCommit>:<path>; require nonempty contracts and all IDs present in packet. No test or coverage pass is inferred from membership.
